<p class="cna-news-lead">CNA has been applied in a study on factors influencing the implementation of a colorectal cancer screening improvement program in community health centers.</p>
<p>New CNA application: Petrik, A., B. Green et al. (2020), Factors influencing implementation of a colorectal cancer screening improvement program in community health centers: an applied use of configurational comparative methods, Journal of General Internal Medicine, doi: 10.1007/s11606-020- 06186-2.</p>
